newsitem.title: FRANCE: Coflexip completes Cal Dive stake purchase.
newsitem.headline: Coflexip completes Cal Dive stake purchase.

text.p: Coflexip Stena Offshore said on Monday it completed the purchase of a 32 percent stake in Cal Dive International Inc for $35 million on April 11.
It said it also completed an agreement with Houston-based Cal Dive to form a strategic alliance to pursue opportunities in the Gulf of Mexico.
The joint venture is expected to pursue engineering, procurement, installation and commissioning projects in deep-water oil and gas fields in the Gulf of Mexico.
Coflexip, with headquarters in Paris, had announced in late February the signing of a letter of intent to buy the stake in Cal Dive and to form the alliance.
